subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should this PR land as a bounded answer-candidate Activity slice after rebase, or should it be folded into the broader native Codex progress work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The implementation is useful and proof-backed, but it defines a new visible Control UI activity surface adjacent to a broader maintainer-marked product decision about safe native Codex progress visibility.

options.title: Land bounded slice after rebase
options.body: Port the change to current `ui/src/pages/**` paths, keep the broader issue open for plan/item/progress UX, and land only the answer-candidate lifecycle surface now.

options.title: Fold into broader Codex progress work
options.body: Hold this PR and implement answer candidates together with the canonical native Codex progress/activity design.

options.title: Reject separate answer-candidate Activity
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if maintainers do not want answer candidates to appear as their own Activity entries.

recommendation.title: Land bounded slice after rebase
recommendation.body: Port the change to current `ui/src/pages/**` paths, keep the broader issue open for plan/item/progress UX, and land only the answer-candidate lifecycle surface now.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent Codex/UI-area history and is one of the maintainers mentioned on the PR timeline for this product-surface decision.
